platePair.en: Juan de Fuca Plate → North American Plate
platePair.es: Placa de Juan de Fuca → Placa Norteamericana

context.en: Full-margin rupture 26 Jan 1700 (M~9.0, dated by orphan-tsunami and tree-ring records); geodetically locked, exceptionally quiet instrumentally.
context.es: Ruptura de todo el margen el 26 de enero de 1700 (M~9.0, fechada por registros de tsunami huérfano y anillos de árboles); acoplado geodésicamente y excepcionalmente silencioso instrumentalmente.

couplingPrior.sourceName: McCaffrey et al. (2007, 2013) — fully locked Cascadia from GPS; consistent with seismogenic-temperature models (e.g., Wang et al.)

note.en: Segment-average literature prior (central estimate of the cited range). Coupling models differ in patch geometry and amplitude — see methodology.
note.es: A priori de literatura promedio del segmento (estimación central del rango citado). Los modelos de acoplamiento difieren en geometría y amplitud del parche — ver metodología.

greatRuptures.label: 26 Jan 1700 full-margin rupture (dated by orphan-tsunami records in Japan and tree rings)

recurrence.source: Goldfinger et al. (2012) — turbidite record: full-margin recurrence ~430–500 a
